control.title: How you stay in control
control.approvalText: CaiMao can prepare a payment, but only your confirmation sends it. The server checks that approval again.
control.rulesText: Transfer rules are checked when CaiMao recommends a route and again when it prepares the payment.
control.recordText: Each step is written to an append-only log with the tool used, its permission level and the result.

technical.title: View technical audit log
technical.summary: {events} financial events across {runs} workflow runs, with tools, permission levels and results
technical.footnote: Reads such as balance and profile lookups are logged too and included in the export. Audit entries are append-only in the database.
